settings.card_text: Strawberry flavoured liquid magnesium for children aged 4 and over.

settings.note: Once a day · about 60 days per bottle

settings.heading: How much to
settings.text: Use the marked pipette, then give the drops straight onto the tongue or stir them into a drink. Shake the bottle first.
settings.caution: Stick to the daily amount for your child's age and don't give more. Dream Drops aren't suitable for children under 4. If your child takes medication or has a medical condition, speak to your GP or pharmacist before starting.

settings.title: Check first if unsure
settings.text: Talk to your GP or pharmacist if your child takes medication or another supplement.

settings.question: What's the best time of day to give it?
settings.answer: Most families give Dream Drops in the evening as part of the wind-down routine, but any time works. Giving it at about the same time each day is what matters most.

settings.question: Can I mix it into a drink?
settings.answer: Yes. Stir the dose into a small amount of water, juice or a smoothie and make sure your child finishes it, so they get the full amount.

settings.question: What if we miss a day?
settings.answer: Just carry on as normal the next day. Don't double the dose to make up for it.

settings.question: How should I store the bottle?
settings.answer: Keep the lid closed and store it somewhere cool and dry, out of direct sunlight and out of children's reach. Shake well before each use.

settings.question: I'm buying for more than one child. How many bottles do I need?
settings.answer: Each bottle holds 60 ml. A child aged 4–7 uses about 30 ml a month and a child aged 8+ uses about 60 ml a month, so add up each child's monthly amount to work out how many bottles you need.

settings.question: Can it be taken with other supplements?
settings.answer: Vitamins and minerals add up across products, so check the labels of anything else your child takes. If you're unsure, ask your GP or pharmacist before combining them.
